en.headline: Police investigate HK$40 million jewellery theft from Chung Hom Kok home
en.dek: A 56-year-old woman reported a pearl necklace valued at about HK$39 million and a diamond necklace worth HK$700,000 missing after returning from Britain.
body: Police are investigating the disappearance of jewellery valued at nearly HK$40 million from a four-storey detached house at Bauhinia Garden, 42 Chung Hom Kok Road, in the Southern district.

The 56-year-old homeowner reported the loss at about 1pm on Thursday, two days after returning from a trip to Britain. She told officers she had placed a pearl necklace worth about HK$39 million and a diamond necklace valued at HK$700,000 in a cabinet inside the third-floor cloakroom on 19 September before leaving.

Officers found no signs of forced entry or disturbance inside the property. During her absence the house was occupied by her 85-year-old mother and two foreign domestic helpers. Police have classified the case as theft and are tracing the helpers for inquiry. No arrests have been made.
The Western District crime unit is handling the investigation. The missing items include a Boghossian pearl necklace and a Cartier diamond necklace, according to reports from the scene.

zh.headline: 春碣角獨立屋報失近四千萬元珠寶 警方列盜竊調查
zh.dek: 56歲女戶主返港後發現衣帽間內一條約值三千九百萬元珍珠頸鏈及一條七十萬元鑽石頸鏈失蹤，屋內無撬毀痕迹。
body: 警方正調查港島南區春碣角道42號紫荊園一幢四層高獨立屋失竊近四千萬元珠寶的案件。
56歲女戶主周四下午約一時報案，她兩日前由英國返港，發現九月十九日離港前存放在三樓衣帽間櫃內的一條約值三千九百萬元珍珠頸鏈及一條七十萬元鑽石頸鏈不翼而飛。
現場沒有撬毀或翻動痕迹。女戶主離港期間，屋內僅有其85歲母親及兩名外籍家庭傭工留守。警方已將案件列作盜竊，正追查兩名家傭，暫時無人被捕。
案件由西區重案組跟進。據了解，失竊珠寶包括一條Boghossian珍珠頸鏈及一條卡地亞鑽石頸鏈。
